prerequisites: Invited account, Mailpit activation message, and a separate authenticated session.
actions: Activate the account, sign in, enroll and use two-factor authentication, then sign out.
expectedResults: The intended account reaches its permitted landing page; two-factor and session controls have their documented effects.
negativeChecks: Expired activation, incorrect password/code, and revoked-session behavior are observable without exposing another account.

prerequisites: Portal enabled for helix.example; Jonas and Amara use separate browser contexts.
actions: Request and redeem a magic link, sign out, then try an expired or already-used link.
expectedResults: Only the intended Business User session opens; the portal shows that person's Requests.
negativeChecks: An unapproved domain gets the supported refusal/neutral response; a bad link offers a working recovery route.

prerequisites: Seeded Tasks, Key dates, and records reached by each role.
actions: Use Home, all Tasks, record sections, and the keyboard-shortcuts sheet to find a named fixture.
expectedResults: Links reach the intended records; Tasks remain distinct from deadline surfaces; ? opens shortcuts.
negativeChecks: Empty sections and unavailable records have useful outcomes; / and Escape retain their existing behavior.

prerequisites: Two visible records, a confidential record outside reach, and a Document with extracted unique text.
actions: Search for the unique text; filter/sort a list, save a view, change filters, and use Back/Forward.
expectedResults: Results respect reach and the saved view restores its configuration; URL, chips, and rows agree.
negativeChecks: The hidden record never appears; no-match search and failed reads preserve understandable state. Track rapid-click issue #751 separately.

prerequisites: Separate personal accounts with known initial timezone and appearance.
actions: Change profile, timezone, and theme; switch to the portal and exercise personal session controls.
expectedResults: Preferences persist for the intended user and the documented app-view path works on this baseline.
negativeChecks: Another account's preferences remain unchanged; no absent M33 App view route is claimed.

prerequisites: Public and confidential Contracts/Matters, two teams, and a confidential Entity with explicit Grants.
actions: Compare the same record links as Administrator, Legal Team Member, Contributor, and Business User; add/remove permitted reach.
expectedResults: Each account sees only its permitted records/actions, including the Administrator exception.
negativeChecks: Removed membership/Grants cease granting access; parent or related-record links do not grant inherited reach.

prerequisites: A reached Contract, Matter, and Request conversation, plus small fictional attachments.
actions: Post comments at available visibility tiers, mention a person, attach paper, and inspect activity as each audience.
expectedResults: Allowed recipients see the intended conversation and attachments; the activity records the action.
negativeChecks: Legal Only and Working Team content stay outside the Business User view; failed attachments do not falsely appear filed.

prerequisites: Separate role accounts, Mailpit, and a controlled event that produces a notification.
actions: Open a notification, change bell/email preferences, trigger another event, and inspect the corresponding destinations.
expectedResults: Links open permitted records and each preference affects its documented channel/event group.
negativeChecks: Portal preferences expose only supported groups; disabled email, unavailable records, and timing/timezone limits are explained.

prerequisites: A published request type with required Fields, deflection guidance, and a small PDF.
actions: Choose the type, complete the form, attach the PDF, submit, and open the new Request.
expectedResults: One Request has the supplied values and successful attachments and appears for its Requester.
negativeChecks: Missing required values prevent submission; attachment failure is reported without concealing a successfully created Request.

prerequisites: Jonas's open Request and a Legal Team Member able to act on it.
actions: Reply from both roles, supply additional paper, and follow the Request through disposition.
expectedResults: The Requester sees the supported progress and conversation for their own Request after disposition.
negativeChecks: A second Business User cannot open it; Legal-only conversation and internal work details remain unavailable.

prerequisites: Published portal Knowledge, restricted/unpublished Knowledge, and configured deflection links.
actions: Follow portal guidance and open its primary/supporting Documents before starting a Request.
expectedResults: Only eligible published Knowledge appears and allowed files open through their intended links.
negativeChecks: Unpublished or out-of-audience items and their files remain unavailable; a broken external link does not block the Request form.

prerequisites: Separate undecided Requests for Convert, Resolve, and Decline, plus two legal sessions.
actions: Review and assign Requests, record each disposition, and revisit the Inbox.
expectedResults: Dispositioned Requests leave the undecided Inbox and retain their recorded outcome.
negativeChecks: A concurrent disposition produces a clear lost-race result rather than a second outcome.

prerequisites: Contract-targeting and Matter-targeting Request types with Fields, attachments, and comments.
actions: Convert one Request through each target, repair required carried values, and inspect the new work and original Request.
expectedResults: Each Request creates one work object of its configured target; paper and conversation retain the documented ownership and reach.
negativeChecks: Concurrent conversion, archived carried references, and missing required values have supported repair or refusal paths.

prerequisites: Active Entity, Counterparties, Contract type, prospective Owner, and team members.
actions: Create a Contract, choose our Entity and Counterparties, assign its Owner/team, and edit business Fields.
expectedResults: The Contract stores the intended parties, accountability, and values and is reached by the expected people.
negativeChecks: Required/invalid values and archived references are handled without creating an unintended Contract.

prerequisites: Contract Statuses covering the fixed Stages and an editable Contract.
actions: Move through representative Statuses and inspect the displayed Stage and activity.
expectedResults: Status labels use their configured Stage mapping and each successful move is visible.
negativeChecks: An archived/read-only record offers no unsupported mutation; renaming a Status does not change its Stage.

prerequisites: Editable Contract, two approvers, and a second actor for cancellation/rejection cases.
actions: Request approvals, answer as the named people, re-request after rejection, and cross the Soft gate deliberately.
expectedResults: Approval requests remain independent; the confirmed override is recorded and the Stage move succeeds.
negativeChecks: A different user cannot answer someone else's request; unresolved approval is a warning, not an invented hard lock.

prerequisites: Contract with an uploaded fictional executed PDF; no Signing connector.
actions: Use the Manual hand-off, choose the Executed pin, and move to the intended active Status.
expectedResults: The selected Document Version is explicitly pinned and the Contract reaches the chosen Stage without a connector.
negativeChecks: A Version kind alone does not set the Executed pin; unsupported users cannot perform the legal action.

prerequisites: Dedicated signing-workflow fixture with a declared provider mode and fictional paper/Signers.
actions: Send an Envelope, observe completion, and use separate Envelopes for void/decline/retry cases.
expectedResults: OpenLaw records the correct Envelope transitions and files/pins the returned executed paper once.
negativeChecks: Unavailable/disabled configuration, a second live Envelope, and provider failure have the documented outcomes. Local stand-ins do not satisfy C42 setup checks.

prerequisites: Contracts with fixed terms, notice periods, and representative renewal options.
actions: Edit the term, inspect derived notice/next-deadline values, and confirm a proposed renewal.
expectedResults: The displayed dates reflect the recorded term and the renewal changes the term only through the supported action.
negativeChecks: Invalid or stale dates are refused/re-read; Task due dates are not substituted for Contract deadlines.

prerequisites: Contract team, an open Task, a Key date, and controlled notification timing.
actions: Create/complete/reorder Tasks and add/change a Key date; inspect Home and notification destinations.
expectedResults: Task and Key date updates persist and affect their distinct supported surfaces.
negativeChecks: Read-only/archived restrictions and missing recipients do not produce misleading reminder promises.

prerequisites: Several Contracts, a parent relation, a typed relation, and one restricted target.
actions: Create/remove relations and exercise ending, archive, and restore on separate fixtures.
expectedResults: Relations, lifecycle changes, and recorded history match the visible actions without granting reach.
negativeChecks: Cycles/invalid links are refused; a restricted target does not leak its details.

prerequisites: A dedicated Analysis fixture, known extracted text, target Fields, and a declared local or live AI provider.
actions: Run Analysis, inspect evidence and Unverified values, confirm/edit one value, and rerun against changed input.
expectedResults: Evidence is tied to the chosen Document Version; confirming one value does not clear unrelated markers.
negativeChecks: Disabled connector, failed extraction, changed source, and stale evidence have the documented states. C43 separately verifies real provider setup.

prerequisites: Matter type/template, Entity/Counterparty references, Matter Manager, and team.
actions: Create a Matter directly and from a template, then edit its supported business Fields.
expectedResults: The Matter has its intended Manager, team, references, and template defaults.
negativeChecks: Missing required values and unavailable templates produce the supported validation or selection behavior.

prerequisites: Open and closed Matter Statuses and separate active/archived Matter fixtures.
actions: Change Status, close/reopen, archive, and restore using allowed accounts.
expectedResults: The selected Status retains its immutable open/closed Category and lifecycle changes persist.
negativeChecks: An archived Matter cannot be edited through ordinary controls; Contributor restrictions remain clear.

prerequisites: Reached Matter with people, Tasks, Key dates, and related work.
actions: Maintain Tasks/Key dates and add/remove permitted relationships.
expectedResults: Checklist work, deadlines, relationships, and corresponding history remain distinct and accurate.
negativeChecks: Invalid cycles/restricted targets and unauthorized changes do not expose or alter hidden work.

prerequisites: Ravi is on one Contract and Matter team and absent from comparable records.
actions: Edit permitted business Fields, add supporting Documents, and comment as Ravi.
expectedResults: Contributor actions succeed only on reached work and the guide identifies the actual legal-action limits.
negativeChecks: Stage/Status moves and other reserved legal actions remain unavailable; removing Ravi's reach stops access.

prerequisites: Reached owning records, PDF/Word fixtures, two Versions, and comment paper.
actions: Upload a Document, append a Document Version, inspect provenance/kind, and file conversation paper.
expectedResults: A logical Document retains its linear Version chain and the paper's ownership/provenance is visible.
negativeChecks: Unsupported corrections, failed uploads, and insufficient access do not silently alter a Version or its provenance.

prerequisites: A reached record, nested local folders, valid files, and one intentionally failing file.
actions: Create/move supported folders and perform bulk/folder upload with a partial failure.
expectedResults: Successful files remain available and the failed item is identified separately.
negativeChecks: Unsupported folder actions or uploads are refused for the relevant role without claiming the whole batch succeeded.

prerequisites: Real PDF, DOCX, scanned PDF, unsupported file, and an isolated processing-failure fixture.
actions: Open previews, wait for processing/OCR, download the original, and retry/recover after the induced failure.
expectedResults: Supported renditions/text become available and downloads preserve the original bytes.
negativeChecks: Failure/unsupported states offer the documented download or recovery path; portal file reach is checked separately.

prerequisites: Two Word Versions and a PDF/text pair with known small differences.
actions: Compare both pairs, read changes, and export a Generated redline where permitted.
expectedResults: Comparison operands and output are correct; an exported redline is a new derived Version with provenance.
negativeChecks: Pending/failed processing and unauthorized export are handled; a Comparison is not misrepresented as a Version.

prerequisites: Documents under several owner kinds, including a hidden owner and an archived Document.
actions: Search/filter the repository and open owners and Version histories.
expectedResults: The repository shows permitted Documents and links to the correct owners/Versions.
negativeChecks: Hidden owners do not leak through results or filters; archived/empty result behavior matches the guide.

prerequisites: Editable Entity types and a separate external Counterparty fixture.
actions: Create/update an Entity and select each party kind in a work record.
expectedResults: Our Entity and external Counterparty retain their distinct roles and labels.
negativeChecks: A Contributor cannot use the Member+ Entity destination; duplicate/invalid input has a clear outcome.

prerequisites: Two Entities, an Officer, a Registration, and fictional corporate Documents.
actions: Record a Holding, Officer appointment, Registration, and Document; archive/restore a separate Entity.
expectedResults: The entered corporate facts and files persist with their supported dates and relationships.
negativeChecks: Invalid ownership/date values and archived/read-only restrictions are handled without changing unrelated facts.

prerequisites: Knowledge types/folders and a draft Knowledge Item with fictional Documents.
actions: Create and organize an item, edit guidance, and choose its primary Document.
expectedResults: The item, its guidance, its folder, and its Documents remain distinct records with a working primary choice.
negativeChecks: Unavailable/archived references and insufficient role permissions have supported outcomes.

prerequisites: A draft Knowledge Item, a portal reader, and an out-of-audience comparison reader.
actions: Publish to a chosen audience, inspect the portal, then unpublish/archive the item.
expectedResults: Only the intended published audience reaches the item and its files; later removal takes effect.
negativeChecks: Direct links do not bypass publication/audience checks, including links to supporting Documents.

prerequisites: Fresh unseeded app and Mailpit; a fictional first Administrator.
actions: Complete account setup and the baseline welcome/authentication/portal/email/invite wizard.
expectedResults: The Administrator reaches the app and the saved settings reflect the completed steps.
negativeChecks: Validation/retry and resumed onboarding work; no M33 checklist or Review step absent from this build is claimed.

prerequisites: Daniel's Administrator account, Mailpit, and disposable invited users.
actions: Edit organization identity, invite/activate a user, change role, revoke sessions, and archive the user.
expectedResults: Changes apply to the intended account and revoked sessions cease granting access.
negativeChecks: Unauthorized administration, invalid invites, and self/last-Administrator safeguards behave as implemented.

prerequisites: Separate authentication lab, Mailpit, allowed domains, and a local OIDC/SAML fixture where supported.
actions: Configure supported sign-in/domain/email options and verify their actual entry flows and environment precedence.
expectedResults: Allowed users can sign in and test mail reaches the controlled sink through the active configuration source.
negativeChecks: Invalid issuer/relay, denied domain, and locked environment settings have recoverable outcomes without exposing secrets.

prerequisites: Administrator, active types/Statuses/Fields, and records retaining values from a retired definition.
actions: Configure definitions and requiredness, then archive/reassign representative entries.
expectedResults: New and existing records reflect the documented configuration and retained-value behavior.
negativeChecks: Immutable Stage/Category mappings and invalid reassignment are refused; non-Administrators cannot edit configuration.

prerequisites: Matter template with default priority/risk and relative Tasks/Key dates.
actions: Configure the template and apply it through direct Matter creation and Request conversion.
expectedResults: Each path creates the intended defaults using its actual date anchor.
negativeChecks: Changing the template does not rewrite already-created work; unavailable templates have a clear outcome.

prerequisites: Administrator, Contract/Matter types, Fields, and portal Knowledge/URL guidance.
actions: Configure one Request type for each conversion target and submit through the resulting forms.
expectedResults: Each form collects the intended values and conversion follows the configured target.
negativeChecks: Invalid/missing required Fields and archived targets do not silently route work to a different module.

prerequisites: Administrator, controlled event timestamps, and Mailpit.
actions: Set reminder lead times, trigger appropriate test events, and find their Administrator audit entries.
expectedResults: Lead-time changes and audit facts are observable at the documented scope.
negativeChecks: The audit log is unavailable to other roles; timezone/channel limits and missing events are investigated rather than assumed.

prerequisites: A real disposable DocuSign developer account, consent/configuration access, and fictional paper.
actions: Follow current provider instructions, configure the Signing connector, test it, and complete a controlled Envelope round trip.
expectedResults: The actual provider account is reached and OpenLaw receives the intended status and executed paper.
negativeChecks: Invalid credentials, disabled connector, webhook/reconciliation recovery, and secret rotation are tested without treating a stand-in as provider setup.

prerequisites: A real disposable supported AI-provider account and a small fictional document with a bounded test input.
actions: Configure and test the AI connector, configure a Field prompt, perform an Analysis run, and disable the connector.
expectedResults: The actual configured provider receives the intended input and OpenLaw records its supported output/evidence.
negativeChecks: Invalid key/model/endpoint, provider refusal, and disabling produce the documented behavior without claiming model accuracy.

prerequisites: Disposable host/project, selected immutable app/engine images, and a fictional operator with the draft guide.
actions: Independently follow the production installation guide from an empty state and time the path to usable setup.
expectedResults: The app reaches readiness and first-run setup with the documented production defaults and topology.
negativeChecks: Missing secrets, occupied ports, and unavailable dependencies lead to the documented recovery; the authoring lab is not counted as production install evidence.

prerequisites: Disposable production-like installation, local reverse proxy, filesystem storage, and local S3-compatible storage.
actions: Apply documented proxy, database, storage, file-limit, mail, engine, worker, and encryption settings.
expectedResults: Each claimed configuration path is demonstrated with actual requests/files and recorded effective values excluding secrets.
negativeChecks: Wrong origin, limits, unavailable storage/engine, and mismatched encryption keys fail as documented and recover after correction.

prerequisites: Pinned earlier supported image with populated records/files/configuration and a separate upgrade target.
actions: Capture the baseline, follow the upgrade guide, and compare retained data and behavior after migration.
expectedResults: Accounts, permissions, records, files, and required encrypted configuration survive the supported upgrade.
negativeChecks: Exercise backup-based recovery in a separate target; do not imply that downgrading a migrated database is supported.

prerequisites: Populated disposable source with known file hashes and encrypted configuration; separate recovery target and retained keys.
actions: Take the coherent backup described by the guide, restore into the empty target, and use the restored app.
expectedResults: Records and permissions work, file hashes match, and required encrypted configuration is usable with the retained key.
negativeChecks: Missing/wrong keys or missing files are detected; a backup archive alone never counts as a successful restore.

prerequisites: Dedicated fault-injection installation with recoverable configuration and baseline health results.
actions: Diagnose controlled startup, migration, mail, worker, processing, storage, and connector failures using the guide.
expectedResults: Each diagnosis reaches a concrete cause or supported escalation and restored service is actually checked.
negativeChecks: Logs and reports omit credentials/private payloads; no destructive recovery is offered without its actual scope and consequence.

prerequisites: Named app error fixtures from access, upload, preview, notifications, approvals, signing, and Analysis scenarios.
actions: Start from each visible symptom and follow the troubleshooting article's checks and recovery links.
expectedResults: The intended reader reaches an accurate resolution or a specific escalation with useful non-sensitive facts.
negativeChecks: The article does not offer an access bypass, invent an unavailable action, or treat a provider stand-in as live-provider evidence.

prerequisites: The target build's glossary, configured labels, role fixtures, and file-behavior examples.
actions: Look up representative terms and limits, then compare the references with the relevant app actions.
expectedResults: The reference separates fixed concepts from configured labels and accurately states role/file limits.
negativeChecks: Examples do not equate Entity with Counterparty, Task due dates with Key dates, or Comparison with Document Version.

prerequisites: Installed documentation edition, standalone export, and an older or unavailable article link.
actions: Identify the app/docs edition, follow version/support links, and inspect the unavailable-link behavior.
expectedResults: The reader can identify supported build/content and reach the intended local or external support path.
negativeChecks: An older app does not silently switch to latest; an external-site failure leaves local reading usable.

prerequisites: Entity with recurring and one-off Obligations and a controlled calendar anchor.
actions: Create an Obligation, inspect its calendar/Home presence, record filing, and advance a recurrence.
expectedResults: Filing history and the next cycle follow the confirmed action and supported recurrence rule.
negativeChecks: Past-due items do not silently count as filed; invalid dates and unauthorized changes have a clear outcome.

prerequisites: Ownership graph, share capital, linked work, confidential Entity, and allowed/denied readers.
actions: Edit supported capital facts, inspect the chart/links, and grant then remove confidential access.
expectedResults: Corporate facts and graph edges are accurate and explicit Grants control the intended reach.
negativeChecks: Restricted linked records remain protected; a Holding or chart relationship does not grant access.

prerequisites: Disposable Documents with multiple Versions and independent Administrator/Member/Contributor sessions.
actions: Archive/restore permitted Documents and permanently delete a separate Document as Administrator.
expectedResults: Archive/restore preserves supported history; permanent deletion removes the documented Versions/files and references.
negativeChecks: Other roles cannot perform Administrator deletion; consequences and unavailable-file behavior match the guide.

prerequisites: Administrator, two Member+ approvers, and a Contract with an applied group.
actions: Create/edit/archive an Approver group and apply it to a Contract before changing its membership.
expectedResults: Applying a group snapshots members into Approval requests; later group edits do not rewrite those requests.
negativeChecks: Non-Member+ selections and unauthorized configuration are refused; existing requests retain their recorded identities.

prerequisites: Help and formal readers plus verified intake pilot articles.
actions: Find the pilot answers through staff/portal Help and signed-out formal guidance; use keyboard, narrow layout, zoom, and all three themes.
expectedResults: All destinations, topic fallbacks, search results, focus, and existing shortcuts work without searching organization records.
negativeChecks: Unknown or missing article/anchor and unavailable external support/reference destinations preserve useful local navigation.

prerequisites: A copied standalone edition retained outside the disposable instance.
actions: Block internet access and read the app bundle, then stop the instance and open the standalone edition from disk.
expectedResults: Local reading and search work without external requests; standalone index/prose also work without JavaScript.
negativeChecks: Blocked external requests do not break local reading while the instance is reachable.
After stopping the instance, a separately retained standalone copy remains readable from disk.
With JavaScript disabled or an optional image/search asset missing, the standalone index and prose remain usable; a missing article file is reported as a failed completeness check.
